parameters.jsCode: const a=$input.first()?.json??{};const rid=a.request_id??null;const memId='MEMOP-'+(rid||'rejected')+'-'+Date.now();const VALID_CATEGORIES=['INVALID_INPUT','INVALID_JSON','UNAUTHORIZED','FORBIDDEN','NOT_FOUND','MODEL_ERROR','PROVIDER_RATE_LIMIT','PROVIDER_TIMEOUT','VALIDATION_FAILED','TEST_FAILED','APPROVAL_REQUIRED','VERSION_CONFLICT','INTEGRATION_UNAVAILABLE','INTERNAL_ERROR'];const rawCat=a.category||'INVALID_INPUT';const cat=VALID_CATEGORIES.includes(rawCat)?rawCat:'INVALID_INPUT';const msg=a.message||'Invalid request';const httpMap={INVALID_INPUT:400,INVALID_JSON:400,UNAUTHORIZED:401,FORBIDDEN:403,NOT_FOUND:404,APPROVAL_REQUIRED:409,VERSION_CONFLICT:409,VALIDATION_FAILED:422,TEST_FAILED:422,PROVIDER_RATE_LIMIT:429,PROVIDER_TIMEOUT:504,MODEL_ERROR:502,INTEGRATION_UNAVAILABLE:503,INTERNAL_ERROR:500};const httpStatus=(typeof a.http_status==='number')?a.http_status:(httpMap[cat]||400);return [{json:{request_id:rid,task_id:a.task_id||null,status:'failed',_http_status:httpStatus,result:{operation_id:memId,operation:null,memory_items:[],memory_item:null,count:0,superseded_count:0,duplicate_detected:false,limitations:['No memory operation performed due to input validation failure.'],verification_summary:{status:'not_verified',evidence:[],source:'none',ai_used:false}},errors:[{category:cat,message:msg}],warnings:[],verification:{status:'not_verified',evidence:[],persisted:false,persist_record_id:null},_persist:{claimed_user_id:a.user_id||null,project_id:a.project_id||null,user_id:null,workspace_id:a.workspace_id||null,conversation_id:a.conversation_id||null,resource_type:'memory_operation_rejected',resource_id:memId,event_type:'memory_operation_rejected',note:'Rejected request: user identity not verified by trusted backend.'}}}];

conditions.leftValue: ={{ (() => { try { const pol=$('Validate Request').first().json.duplicate_policy; if(pol!=='reject') return false; const meta=$('Validate Request').first().json; const rows=$('Write Memory DupCheck').all().map(i=>i.json).filter(r=>r&&r.id); return rows.some(r => { if(meta.idempotency_key && r.idempotency_key === meta.idempotency_key) return true; if(!meta.key) return false; if(r.key !== meta.key) return false; if(r.scope !== meta.scope) return false; if(meta.scope === 'project' && r.project_id !== meta.project_id) return false; if(meta.scope === 'workspace' && r.workspace_id !== meta.workspace_id) return false; if(meta.scope === 'workflow' && r.workflow_id !== meta.workflow_id) return false; if(meta.scope === 'skill' && r.skill_id !== meta.skill_id) return false; if(meta.scope === 'conversation') { const ref = r.source_reference || {}; if(ref.conversation_id !== meta.conversation_id) return false; } return true; }); } catch(e) { return false; } })() }}

fieldValues.fieldValue: ={{ $('Validate Request').first().json.confidence !== null && $('Validate Request').first().json.confidence !== undefined ? $('Validate Request').first().json.confidence : null }}

conditions.leftValue: ={{ (() => { try { const t=$json; const m=$('Validate Request').first().json; if(!t||t.id!==m.memory_id) return false; if(t.knowledge_status==='superseded') return false; if(m.project_id&&t.project_id&&t.project_id!==m.project_id) return false; if(m.workspace_id&&t.workspace_id&&t.workspace_id!==m.workspace_id) return false; if(m.conversation_id){ const r=(t.source_reference&&typeof t.source_reference==='object')?t.source_reference:{}; if(r.conversation_id!==m.conversation_id) return false; } return true; } catch(e) { return false; } })() }}

={{ (() => { try { const a=$('Fetch Memory Target').first().json; const b=$json; const m=$('Validate Request').first().json; if(!a||!a.id||a.id!==m.memory_id) return false; if(!b||!b.id||b.id!==m.superseded_by) return false; if(a.knowledge_status==='superseded') return false; if(b.knowledge_status==='superseded') return false; if(b.superseded_by) return false; if(m.scope&&a.scope&&a.scope!==m.scope) return false; if(m.scope&&b.scope&&b.scope!==m.scope) return false; if(m.scope==='project'&&m.project_id){ if(a.project_id&&a.project_id!==m.project_id) return false; if(b.project_id&&b.project_id!==m.project_id) return false; } if(m.scope==='workspace'&&m.workspace_id){ if(a.workspace_id&&a.workspace_id!==m.workspace_id) return false; if(b.workspace_id&&b.workspace_id!==m.workspace_id) return false; } if(m.scope==='conversation'&&m.conversation_id){ const rA=a.source_reference||{}; const rB=b.source_reference||{}; if(rA.conversation_id&&rA.conversation_id!==m.conversation_id) return false; if(rB.conversation_id&&rB.conversation_id!==m.conversation_id) return false; } if(m.scope==='workflow'&&m.workflow_id){ if(a.workflow_id&&a.workflow_id!==m.workflow_id) return false; if(b.workflow_id&&b.workflow_id!==m.workflow_id) return false; } if(m.scope==='skill'&&m.skill_id){ if(a.skill_id&&a.skill_id!==m.skill_id) return false; if(b.skill_id&&b.skill_id!==m.skill_id) return false; } return true; } catch(e) { return false; } })() }}
